clauses.title: Requriements for cast iron
clauses.text: 1.1 Requriements for cast iron pipes for pressure main lines of water gas and sewage manufactured by vertical casing in sand moulds.

clauses.title: Applicable to pipes with
clauses.text: 1.2 Applicable to pipes with sockets (for lead joints) or flanges.  Standard may also be made applicable to other types of joints specially rubber joints, where overall measuements shall be adhered to, to ensure interchangeability.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength
clauses.text: 2.2 Tensile Strength— shall not be lower than 15 kgf/ mm2

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Test
clauses.text: 2.3 Hydrostatic Test — Pipes shall with stand following test pressures kgf/cm2. Diameter      Socket and              Flanged Pipe Spigot Pipes Class A  Class B  ClassA   Class B 1) Up to  300 mm   20 25 20 25 2) Over   300 and up to   600 mm  20 25 15 20 3) Over   600 and up to 1000 mm  15 20 10 15 4) Over 1000 and up to 1500 mm  10 15 10 10 For detailed information, refer to IS 1537 : 1976  Specification for vertically cast iron pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage (first revision).

clauses.title: Sizes
clauses.text: 3. Sizes a) Working lenght of socket and spigot pipes 3.66, 4, 4.88, 5 and 5.5 m. b) Working length of flanged pipes  2 to 3 m  for 80 mm nominal diameter pipe and 2 to 4 m for others. c)  Norminal diameter of socket  and spigot pipes and flanged pipes  80, 100,125, 150,  200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500,  600, 700, 750, 800, 900,1 000, 1 100, 1 200, 1 500. d) Tolerances 1) Length (socket and spigot, and plain ended pipes) 2) Length (flanged pipes) ± 10 mm. 3) Maximum deviation from straight line shall not exceed (1.2 L) mm where l is length in  meters. Note— For dimesions of sockets, spigots, flanges, etc,  refer to the standard.

clauses.title: Mass
clauses.text: 4. Mass — Density  of  cast  iron  is taken as 7.15 kg/ dm3.

clauses.title: Tolerance on standard mass
clauses.text: 4.1 Tolerance on standard mass 5 percent. SUMMARY OF IS 1537 : 1976 VERTICALLY CAST IRON PRESSURE PIPES FOR WATER, GAS AND SEWAGE (First Revision) ±
